definitions.explanation: To fail to remember something, or to leave something behind unintentionally.

examples.japanese: {傘|かさ}を{電車|でんしゃ}に{忘|わす}れました。
examples.english: I left my umbrella on the train.

examples.japanese: {約束|やくそく}を{忘|わす}れて{友達|ともだち}を{待|ま}たせてしまった。{本当|ほんとう}に{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}なかった。
examples.english: I forgot our promise and kept my friend waiting. I was really sorry.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). No pair verb. Pattern: Xを{忘|わす}れる (forget X).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {忘|わす}れている = 'has forgotten' (doesn't remember).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{名前|なまえ}を{忘|わす}れる (forget a name)
・{傘|かさ}を{忘|わす}れる (leave umbrella behind)
・{忘|わす}れてしまう (unfortunately forget)
・{忘|わす}れないで (don't forget)

Ichidan verb: te-form {忘|わす}れて.

Related:
- {忘|わす}れ{物|もの} (forgotten item)
- {忘年会|ぼうねんかい} (year-end party).
